notes.content:

Please check in-game options or discussions page for instructions how to do that.

notes.content: Fixed root motion for some pets, that caused them to be stuck

notes.title: Custom number of Random Dungeon Levels
notes.content: Added option to choose custom number of random dungeon levels (anything between 1..32)

notes.title: Full Translation + Gamepad Improvements
notes.content:
Fully translated game into several languages, now including all messages, texts, hints inside the main dungeon campaign.

Improved displaying of game controls, keyboard, mouse, gamepad buttons in the Options\Controls menu, now using graphics/images instead of text.

Added native support for multiple gamepads:
-Sony Dualshock 4
-Sony Dualsense
-Nintendo Switch Pro Controller
-8BitDo Pro 2

Added option to invert gamepad look direction.

Game is now on Sale with Limited Time Discount! :)

notes.title: Obstacle Box Too Bix
notes.content: Fixed some obstacle bounding boxes being too big

notes.title: Ranking
notes.content:
Added Ranking system! Players with top Hero Level and most Monster Kills are now included in the global highscore
 Fixed auto shooting when swapping between crossbow and bow

notes.title: Screen Brightness
notes.content:
Added Graphics Option to adjust Screen Brightness
 Block from Shields is now more effective
 Fullscreen blood effect now displays sooner and stronger
 Added language translations to Level Editor and Download Maps menu

notes.title: Alternative Keyboard Layout
notes.content:
Added Alternative Keyboard Input based around arrow keys:

 Arrow Keys = Move
 Enter = Action (open door)
 / (SLASH) = Toggle weapons / Take all items
 DEL = Character Screen
 NumPad0 = Dash


When trying to close door and it's blocked, a message will be shown on the screen.

notes.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
notes.content:
Added keyboard shortcuts for following actions:

 F1 .. F5 - Use Item
 Ctrl+MouseWheel - Change Item
 Ctrl - Walk slowly (instead of run)

notes.title: How to Open Door Hint + Feedback Email
notes.content:
Some people don't know how to open door -> Added hint at the bottom of the screen what key to press (you can hide this in the "Options \ General \ Show Hints")
Added option to enter your email address in the "Feedback" section if you need a reply
